component.name: MiniSnap
component.summary: Screenshots, screen recording and text extraction
Chụp ảnh, quay video màn hình và trích chữ

description.p: MiniSnap is free, open-source screenshot and screen recording software for everyone. Capture a region, a window or the whole screen, annotate it and share it in seconds.

ul.li: Capture a region, a window or the full screen, with a magnifier and exact pixel sizes
Annotate with arrows, boxes, ellipses, lines, a pen, highlights, text, blur and step numbers
Every capture is saved to Pictures/MiniSnap and copied to the clipboard
Record the screen or a region to MP4
Extract text from images (OCR) with Tesseract, including Vietnamese
A library of your images and videos with thumbnails
Vietnamese and English interface; works on Wayland and X11 through xdg-desktop-portal

description.p: MiniSnap collects no data. It only contacts api.github.com to check for updates, which can be turned off.
First Linux version: region, window and full-screen capture through xdg-desktop-portal, annotation editor, screen recording, text extraction and the image & video library.
